newsitem.title: USA: EndoSonics gets imaging color option okay.
newsitem.headline: EndoSonics gets imaging color option okay.

text.p: EndoSonics Corp said Tuesday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to begin marketing its ChromaFlo option for the Oracle InVision ultrasound imaging system.
EndoSonics currently markets the Oracle InVision system, which provides black-and-white cross-sectional images of an artery.
The ChromaFlo option, when added to the Oracle InVision system, uses proprietary technology to detect blood flow and represent it as a color (red).
ChromaFlo is designed to improve the diagnosis of certain anatomical features that may be more apparent when blood flow is differentiated from tissue.
